PIDSMaker no longer needs Postgres or Docker: it installs with pip, downloads its datasets from Hugging Face, and runs on Linux and macOS.

```shell
pip install pidsmaker
pidsmaker velox CADETS_E3      # downloads CADETS_E3 on first use
```

## Breaking changes
- **No Postgres or Docker:** datasets are Parquet files from [`pidsmaker/datasets`](https://huggingface.co/datasets/pidsmaker/datasets), read in place with DuckDB, with identical results. The `--database_*` arguments, Docker and Apptainer files, `download_datasets.sh` and `scripts/run.sh` are removed: use `pidsmaker SYSTEM DATASET`, with `--background` instead of `nohup ./run.sh &`. PIDSMaker 4.x stays at the tag [`4.0.0`](https://github.com/ubc-provenance/PIDSMaker/releases/tag/4.0.0) (#86).
- **Orthrus is non-snooped by default** (word2vec on the training split, no k-means, the settings of `orthrus_non_snooped`, which is removed). The top of `config/orthrus.yml` lists the overrides of the paper (#88, #89).
- **R-Caid, MAGIC, Flash, ThreaTrace and Kairos now follow their paper or original code**, so their results differ from 4.0.0 (e.g. ADP on CADETS_E3: MAGIC 0.04 → 0.70, Flash 0.01 → 0.23) (#83).
- `Ground_Truth/` is renamed `ground_truth/` (#88). Python 3.9 to 3.11 (#86).

## New features
- **[Network intrusion detection](https://ubc-provenance.github.io/PIDSMaker/guide/systems/):** Euler, Argus, Jbeil, LARES, E-GraphSAGE and Anomal-E, on the LANL and OPTC_NET datasets. Systems of both families run on network or provenance datasets (#78, #85).
- **ShadeWatcher and ProGrapher** provenance systems (#84).
- **`pidsmaker` command:** `pidsmaker download <dataset>|all`, automatic download, reproducible environment, `--background` runs with a log file (#86).
- **[macOS](https://ubc-provenance.github.io/PIDSMaker/getting-started/installation/#macos)** (Apple Silicon, on CPU) and machines without a GPU, for most datasets (32 GB of RAM is ideal) (#82).
- **Clearer logs:** one line per task and epoch, the main settings of each task, a summary of the best epoch, colors and progress bars in terminals (#90).
- **[Benchmark](https://ubc-provenance.github.io/PIDSMaker/guide/benchmark/):** time, RAM, GPU memory and disk of every system on six datasets (#87, #89).

## Performance
Faster and leaner pipeline, with identical outputs (#77, #83):
- Orthrus on THEIA_E5: ~3.4 h → ~61 min, 370 → 16.6 GB peak RAM.
- Orthrus on CADETS_E3: 42 → 20 min, 47 → 4.8 GB of RAM, 9.7 → 2.2 GB on disk.
- R-Caid on THEIA_E5: killed above 800 GB of RAM → 7.7 GB.

## Fixes
- Uncertainty experiments (hyperparameter sensitivity, deep ensemble seeds), mixed node- and edge-level objectives, `predict_edge_type` with BCE or `balanced_loss`, `glstm` on OpTC, depimpact triage (#72, #73).
- Clear errors for unsupported combinations of components, instead of crashes deep in the pipeline (#73).
- Node types overwritten between graphs on CPU, evaluation of a single class (#79).

## Docs and community
- Redesigned [documentation](https://ubc-provenance.github.io/PIDSMaker/) (#76, #81), README updates (#75, #80, #91).
- Tests run on every pull request (#79).
- [Discord](https://discord.gg/jecmkTABUg) community and release announcements (#74).
